You will hear Eva asking her uncle about a town visit.
Eva: I want to visit the zoo on Saturday.
Uncle: The school group goes then. Sunday will be quieter.
Eva: Good. Let’s go on Sunday. How can we get there?
Uncle: We can take the underground to the station, then walk.
Eva: Where do we meet?
Uncle: At the bus stop?
Eva: Let’s meet in front of the library instead.
Uncle: Fine. The zoo opens at ten, but we will meet at nine.
Eva: Shall I bring lunch?
Uncle: Yes, bring sandwiches. We can eat at the picnic tables.
